comments.mergedPostTitle: Mic icon still stays on for a second or two after you're done talking

comments.value: This bug still persists nearly 7 years later.

details: I use push to talk in SteamVR advanced settings, and ever since the new patch for some reason when I use push to talk and finish speaking, the mic icon is still lit up like a second or two after I'm finished speaking. I tested to see if it was still recording my voice after I let go of my push to talk button, and even though the mic icon was still lit up 2 seconds after I let go of the push to talk button, my visemes weren't activating when I let go of my push to talk key. So it just seems to be a visual UI error? Either way this wasn't happening before. I can record a video of what I'm talking about if needed, although hopefully others are experiencing this same issue and it's not just me ;_;
title: The mic being on icon stays for like 2 seconds after you're done talking.
